docs.text: Combat Abilities Astral Rebuke Unleash a homing spike that erupts beneath enemies and throws them in the air. Applies Lifted and builds up Astralized . Barrage Sends projectiles hurtling towards a target. Command Take over an enemy's mind and turn them into an ally. Ground Slam Slams enemies from above. The area of effect and amount of Damage can be boosted if executed from higher up. Growth Summon a Mold Ally that shoots spores at enemies. These spores build up Infected over time. Ignite Melee Attacks and Barrage , Shield , and Volatile Anomaly do Fire Damage that applies Burn . Inferno Generates increasingly intense Fire waves applying Burn that builds up. Push Sends enemies flying backwards. Push them off ledges and into hazards for more Damage . Shield Shield absorbs damage. Its durability is equal to the Power meter. Dodge with Shield to Shield Bash . Spike Summon an Astral Spike to attack enemies. It can also be directed to attack and knock down a target. Builds up Astralized . Spore Burst Rapidly fire Mold projectiles at a target, building up Infected . Volatile Anomaly Summon an ally that can be thrown and detonated - does more Damage if the ally has low health.
